name: CloudZao Metalio E-Ink4 Plus (ESP32-S31, 4.7in 1216x684 EPD)
_sources: docs/research/foundation/platform-runtime.md, upstream-firmware.md, docs/research/simulator/performance-modeling.md. Principle until calibrated: time costs take upper bounds, resources take lower bounds.

cpu._coremark_source: ESP32-S31 datasheet v0.5: CoreMark 2195.20 dual-core @320 MHz = 3.43/MHz per core, which needs CPI ~1.0 with GCC 15.2; the closest plausible single-issue model (ISS, tools/iss) gives 3.083 — used here
cpu._notes_cache: I-cache 16 KiB per core, 2-way, 64 B lines; D-cache 64 KiB shared by both cores and by PSRAM and mapped flash (ESP-IDF soc.h / Kconfig.cache, see tools/iss/timing). icache_penalty: extra fraction on annotated system CPU for misses on flash-resident code (ISS: cold small kernels +30%, steady state lower; 0.15 pessimistic, 0.08 expected). flash.line_fill: one 64 B line over DIO 80 MHz flash (ISS flash.fill).

kernel._notes: CONFIG_FREERTOS_HZ=100 upstream: delays/timeouts quantized to 10 ms. ctx switch 10 us / queue op 5 us are pessimistic estimates. FreeRTOS objects live in internal RAM (ESP-IDF).
kernel._notes_stack: host_stack_ratio 1.0 = use host (x86-64) stack use as-is: pessimistic for RV32 (smaller frames, same arrays). Authoritative check: -fstack-usage on the target build.

memory._notes: PESSIMISTIC DEFAULT. internal_heap_kib = internal RAM left for EVERYTHING allocated at run time (display driver buffers, task stacks, TLS, system) after static code/data, excluding the DMA reserve. dma_heap_kib = the upstream SPIRAM_MALLOC_RESERVE_INTERNAL pool: on the S31 (IDF 6.1) it is tried after regular internal RAM for DMA and internal requests and last for default ones; the dma_heap_kib >= 16 budget therefore measures what is left of the reserve, not a separate DMA pool. Static use is unknown until `idf.py size` (foundation 3.2): replace these numbers then. PSRAM assumed 8 MB until 16 MB is confirmed.
memory._notes_regions: The internal heap is several separate regions (memory map, static data, cache-reserved areas); profile guess: the largest block is <= 32 KiB until idf.py size / heap_caps_print_heap_info on the device says otherwise.

display._notes: phase >= 12 ms (EPD_MIN_PHASE_US), pessimistic 16 ms; line 17 us x 688 lines. Upstream 'balanced' default: GC16 36 / GL16 37 / DU 20 phases ('clear' = 48/48). TPS65185 power-up ~140 ms in upstream code (fixed 50+50 ms delays + PG polling), powered off after each refresh (keep_power false). During waveform playback two max-priority epd_prep feeder tasks occupy ~70% of each core. Driver internal 50 KiB is the design target (upstream ~120 KiB).
display._notes_pipeline: Phase = prefill + 688 lines x 17 us + frame-done overhead, padded to 12 ms (EPD_MIN_PHASE_US). Feeders (port design, provisional): two max-priority tasks, next free feeder takes the next line (dynamic), only the update area's columns are converted (the rest of a line is a no-op), 48-line queue per feeder, scan starts after 64 lines, LCD refill interrupt IRAM-safe (CONFIG_LCD_RGB_ISR_IRAM_SAFE + GDMA; callback and queues in internal RAM). line_prep_us 31.8 = optimized C (four pre-shifted 256-byte tables, mask folded in) 28.9 us/1216-px line on the ISS fitted model x1.1; upstream's C path measures 33.4 us there, and upstream's own notes (64-line prefill underruns under concurrent audio, 192 does not) bracket the real cost at ~32-34 us, so the ISS value is used with a small margin rather than the generic x1.3. LUT 1 KiB (1ppB, 4 x 256 B).

input._notes: FT6336U on the shared 100 kHz I2C1 bus with IO expander, fuel gauge, charger, RTC, accelerometer. AI = BOOT key (pending D-19); home/prev/next are cover touch keys.
input._notes_detect: touch_detect_us: finger contact -> INT, estimate (controller scan period in monitor mode)
input._notes_keys: Key sources (upstream config.h): AI = BOOT key on GPIO61 (direct); POWER/VOL+/VOL- on the TCA9555 IO expander (INT on GPIO2 shared with the accelerometer, then I2C reads on the shared bus); HOME/PREV/NEXT are cover keys read by the touch controller (finger at Y~1600, outside the panel): touch INT after touch_detect_us, I2C read, polling until release, paused like touch while the PMIC powers up.

flash._notes: The NOR part on the board is unverified: generic pessimistic values (program 0.7/3 ms per 256-byte page, 4 KiB erase 45/400 ms) instead of one vendor's datasheet. IDF 6.1: one cache-off window per esp_flash_write chunk (CONFIG_SPI_FLASH_WRITE_CHUNK_SIZE 8192 upstream; littlefs programs from its internal buffer = direct write), per erase and per read chunk; SPI1 moves <= 64 bytes per program/read command (spi_cmd_us each). A program command costs program_first_us + its share of the page time. Auto-suspend off upstream; erase yields only between the sectors of one multi-sector erase (littlefs erases one per call).
flash._notes_assets: assets partition (fonts, images) assumed 6 MiB of the 16 MiB flash next to 2 OTA app slots and /user; upstream fontpack alone is ~4.75 MiB

sd._notes: pessimistic: 4-bit 40 MHz theoretical 20 MB/s; S31 path uses a 4 KiB internal bounce buffer upstream

network._notes: estimates (unverified): LTE limited by the 2 Mbaud UART-Ethernet link; RRC idle after ~10 s, resume ~300 ms; TLS 1 session ~40 KiB PSRAM + ~6 KiB internal; esp_websocket_client task 4 KiB; event loop task 2.5 KiB
network._notes_stacks: Port decisions (internal RAM): the WebSocket client task (CONFIG_ESP_WS_CLIENT_TASK_STACK_IN_EXT_RAM, TCB stays internal) and the 4G UART-NIC task keep their stacks in PSRAM — neither calls the flash API. The upstream profile keeps them internal.

audio._notes: BH1098G clocks I2S (ESP is slave): 16 kHz, stereo 32-bit slots, DMA 4 x 240 frames per direction = 60 ms runway (upstream bt_audio_codec.cc). Mic has 2 channels (mic + loopback reference). Output start = I2S enable + NS4150 enable via the TCA9555 over the shared I2C + settle: estimate 30 ms. Opus state from the esp_audio_codec table (48 kHz stereo: enc 29.4 KB, dec 26.6 KB; 16 kHz mono needs less, kept pessimistic). Upstream audio_input task: 4 KB stack in PSRAM, priority 8 (frozen, like every task, while the flash API runs). Opus CPU per 60 ms frame is an ESTIMATE (enc ~12% of one 320 MHz core at complexity 0, dec ~2%); calibrate on the ISS or hardware.

power._notes: ALL ESTIMATES (unmeasured): replace with bench measurements (SP-08). battery_mah is a placeholder; the real cell capacity is unverified.

_notes_costs: costs_cycles: ISS Level-2 calibration (tools/iss, docs/research/simulator/iss-calibration.md, 2026-11-02): PESSIMISTIC values = max(raw x 1.3, slow corner) for copies, glyphs, conversion, JSON, inflate, CRC and the new glyph.px/fill.px/set_byte classes. Not measured on the ISS yet (kept as earlier guesses): lvgl.px, lvgl.refr, text.* (the ISS kernels are leaner than our text engine; measure system/text on the ISS next), heap.op (IDF heap wrapper not modelled), littlefs.op, tls.handshake, opus.*. CoreMark anchor 3.43/MHz needs CPI~1.0; fitted 3.083.
